description: Cheminements piétons dans le Val-de-Marne d'après OpenstreetMap is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Jungle Bus. This dataset describes approximately 9 km of pedestrian paths along departmental lanes in Val-de-Marne: Nogent-sur-Marne: Boulevard de Strasbourg Le Perreux-sur-Marne: Boulevard d'Alsace-Lorraine and Avenue du Général de Gaulle Fontenay-sous-Bois: Avenue du Maréchal de Lattre de Tassigny (south of Rue Carnot) This includes sidewalks, pedestrian crossings with their crossing islands and lowered sidewalks. Coverage: Jungle Bus. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian paths in the Val-de-Marne according to OpenstreetMap" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Jungle Bus. Its keywords include accessibilite, passage-pieton, cheminement-pieton, cheminement, openstreetmap, cheminements-accessibles. The listing shows 2 download or service links in NETEX. The listing shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
